title: Can Robots Take Care of Spacecraft? (ISAAC demo, Astrobee 'Bumble' on the ISS, 2021)
contents: First 66 s of the 1080p file, re-encoded (crf 21). Real ISS footage 0:06-1:04: Astrobee Bumble is alerted to a simulated danger and finds a misplaced 'sock' (a printed sock picture) blocking an air vent. English captions are burned in at the bottom.
